handler.words: One module at the bundle root. It puts the adapter directory on sys.path (the adapter finds lib/opal_naming.py by walking up from its own folder) and imports cottonwood_bd_account_return_daily and trading_calendar. lambda_handler(event, context=None, s3=None, reader=None) runs the adapter's run_day per day. An event {day} runs one day; {days} runs the listed days in the order given; no day key runs the days owed. {dry_run: true} passes upload=False. Every day is validated as a real ISO date and the event is size-checked before any write. More than 25 days raises SystemExit; a bad date raises ValueError. A held day is logged HOLD <day>: <reason> and counted. The return is ok, days, results and held.

closure.words: Found by reading the adapter's imports and opal_naming's file reads (REGISTRY_FILES, the naming schema for key(), the repo-relative lib path), then running the checker's staged probe. The probe passed with all fifteen members. Negative arms on the same probe: without NAMING_SCHEMA.json the probe cannot run; without tiers.json it cannot run; without trading_calendar.py it cannot import. Without reporting_policies.json it still passes, because load_registry reads that file only when it is present; it is kept because the repo carries it and the runtime reads it. The adapter is the run-time core; opal_naming and trading_calendar are its imports; the naming schema is read by key(); the eleven registry files are every file load_registry reads. pyarrow is a package dependency of the adapter and is not a member.

scheduling.words: The first fire runs with no day key: it owes the trading days after the newest landed partition through T-1, at most five, and owes exactly T-1 when nothing has landed. The catch-up from the first non-empty fact_allocations date (2026-04-22) is run by explicit days events, each at most 25 days, so the scheduled fire stays within its five-day cap and the catch-up never runs by implication. The landing facts name the schedule as created DISABLED, with a hold when T-1 silver is absent; this cell does not set or change that. The next round's Terraform must set: timeout (sized for five days of run_day, measured in the next round), memory (sized for one adapter day's silver read), environment (none beyond the default region and no firm key), reserved concurrency of 1 so two fires never write the same gold partition, the handler as handler.lambda_handler, the bundle artifact investor-reporting/irpt-cot-account-return-daily-lambda.zip, and the IAM role with read on the two granted silver tables and put on the gold prefix only.
